Runs Space Ranger 4.1.0 to align reads and perform
nucleus/cell segmentation, then converts the segmented output to SpatialData.

Segmentation runs by default when an H&E microscope image (`--image`) is
provided. Provide `--probe_set` for probe-based Visium HD assays.

## Argument groups

### Inputs

|Name              |Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |Attributes                                                                                                                   |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--id`            |ID of the sample.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |`string`, required, example: `"foo"`                                                                                         |
|`--input`         |The fastq.gz files to align with Space Ranger. Can also be a single directory containing fastq.gz files.  Individual FASTQ files should follow the naming convention of 10x Genomics: [Sample Name]_S[Sample Number]_L[Lane Number]_[Read Type]_001.fastq.gz |List of `file`, required, example: `"sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz", "sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz"`, multiple_sep: `";"` |
|`--gex_reference` |Path of folder containing 10x-compatible reference.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |`file`, required, example: `"/path/to/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A"`                                                            |
|`--probe_set`     |CSV file specifying the probe set used. Omit for Visium HD 3' data (sequencing-based); provide it only for probe-based Visium HD.                                                                                                                            |`file`, example: `"Visium_Mouse_Transcriptome_Probe_Set_v2.0_mm10-2020-A.csv"`                                               |
|`--cytaimage`     |Brightfield image generated by the CytAssist instrument. Required for Visium HD.                                                                                                                                                                             |`file`, required, example: `"cytassist.tiff"`                                                                                |
|`--image`         |H&E microscope image (TIFF or JPG). Required to run nucleus/cell segmentation.                                                                                                                                                                               |`file`, example: `"brightfield.tif"`                                                                                         |


### Outputs

|Name                   |Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |Attributes                                 |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--output_raw`         |Location where the raw Space Ranger output folder will be stored.                                                                                                                                                                                        |`file`, required, example: `"output_dir"`  |
|`--output_spatialdata` |The Space Ranger output, converted to SpatialData (Zarr).                                                                                                                                                                                                |`file`, required, example: `"output.zarr"` |
|`--mode`               |Which Space Ranger HD output to convert to SpatialData: `segmented_cells` (per-cell counts and cell boundary polygons) or `bins` (binned counts at `--bin_size`). Segmentation is generally preferred, but binned output is available for compatibility. |`string`, default: `"segmented_cells"`     |
|`--bin_size`           |Bin size in microns to convert when `--mode bins`.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |`integer`, default: `8`                    |
|`--output_type`        |Which count matrix to convert (`filtered` or `raw`). Applies to both modes.                                                                                                                                                                              |`string`, default: `"filtered"`            |
|`--output_layer`       |If provided, store the counts as a named layer in addition to `.X`.                                                                                                                                                                                      |`string`                                   |
|`--dataset_id`         |Identifier used to name the spatial elements. Defaults to the sample id.                                                                                                                                                                                 |`string`                                   |


### Slide Information

|Name              |Description                                                                                 |Attributes                            |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--slide`         |Visium slide serial number. Optional if present in the CytAssist image metadata.            |`string`                              |
|`--area`          |Visium capture area identifier. Optional if present in the CytAssist image metadata.        |`string`                              |
|`--unknown_slide` |Use if the slide serial number and area are unknown.                                        |`string`                              |
|`--slidefile`     |Slide design file for offline use                                                           |`file`, example: `"slide_design.gpr"` |
|`--override_id`   |Overrides the slide serial number and capture area provided in the Cytassist image metadata |`boolean_true`                        |


### Image Options

|Name                |Description                                                                                                                                                                                    |Attributes                                    |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--darkimage`       |Multi-channel, dark-background fluorescence image                                                                                                                                              |`file`, example: `"fluorescence.tif"`         |
|`--colorizedimage`  |Color image representing pre-colored dark-background fluorescence images                                                                                                                       |`file`, example: `"colored_fluorescence.tif"` |
|`--dapi_index`      |Index of DAPI channel (1-indexed) of fluorescence image                                                                                                                                        |`integer`, example: `1`                       |
|`--image_scale`     |Microns per microscope image pixel                                                                                                                                                             |`double`, example: `0.65`                     |
|`--reorient_images` |Whether to rotate and mirror image to align fiducial pattern                                                                                                                                   |`boolean`, default: `TRUE`                    |
|`--loupe_alignment` |Alignment file produced by the Loupe Browser manual alignment step. Overrides automatic fiducial and tissue detection. The image used to generate this file must match --image or --cytaimage. |`file`, example: `"alignment.json"`           |


### SpaceRanger arguments

|Name                        |Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |Attributes                  |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--create_bam`              |Enable or disable BAM file generation.                                                                                                                                                                                              |`boolean`, default: `FALSE` |
|`--nosecondary`             |Disable secondary analysis (e.g. clustering).                                                                                                                                                                                       |`boolean_true`              |
|`--r1_length`               |Hard trim the input Read 1 to this length before analysis                                                                                                                                                                           |`integer`                   |
|`--r2_length`               |Hard trim the input Read 2 to this length before analysis                                                                                                                                                                           |`integer`                   |
|`--filter_probes`           |Whether to filter the probe set using the "included" column                                                                                                                                                                         |`boolean`, default: `TRUE`  |
|`--custom_bin_size`         |Bin Visium HD data to an additional custom size in microns (4-100, even).                                                                                                                                                           |`integer`                   |
|`--include_introns`         |Include intronic reads in the count. When unset, Space Ranger applies its own default (true for Visium HD 3' and Visium v1, false otherwise).                                                                                       |`boolean`                   |
|`--nucleus_segmentation`    |Enable or disable nucleus/cell segmentation (on by default when an H&E image is given).                                                                                                                                             |`boolean`                   |
|`--cell_annotation_model`   |Cloud-based cell type annotation model to use, which requires `--tenx_cloud_token_path`. When left out, Space Ranger still annotates human samples with the bundled Pan-Human Azimuth model, which runs locally and needs no token. |`string`                    |
|`--tenx_cloud_token_path`   |Path to a 10x Cloud token JSON, required for cloud-based annotation models.                                                                                                                                                         |`file`                      |
|`--disable_cell_annotation` |Disable cell type annotation.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |`boolean_true`              |


### Segmentation Options

|Name                                  |Description                                                                                                                                                  |Attributes                                        |
|:----------|:--------------------------------------------------|:--------------------|
|`--custom_segmentation_file`          |Custom nucleus segmentation mask to use instead of the built-in algorithm. Requires --nucleus_expansion_distance_micron.                                     |`file`, example: `"nucleus_segmentation.geojson"` |
|`--nucleus_expansion_distance_micron` |Distance in microns to expand each nucleus to approximate the cell boundary.                                                                                 |`double`                                          |
|`--max_nucleus_diameter_px`           |Maximum nucleus diameter in pixels, for samples with exceptionally large cells.                                                                              |`integer`                                         |
|`--umi_registration`                  |Enable or disable UMI-based registration that aligns the microscope image to the UMI count data for Visium HD. When unset, Space Ranger applies its default. |`boolean`                                         |
|`--umi_to_image_offset`               |Supply a custom offset (as accepted by Space Ranger) to override UMI-to-image registration when automatic convergence is incorrect.                          |`string`                                          |

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

<details>
<summary>Example of `params.yaml`</summary>

Generate a `params.yaml` for this component on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping).

</details>

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/spaceranger_hd_mapping/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

:::{.callout-note}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend.
:::

Running on Seqera or through Viash Hub is explained in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
